content.text: Saturday you've got soccer practice at 10:00am at Cedarvale Park. After that, there's Central Library story time at the Bloor/Gladstone branch on Sat, Aug 8. It's free and indoors, but it's a drop-in with no set time that I can see. It's also forecast to be a hot, dry day, so you could skip it and go outside instead. [link-c9bfa2]
